body:
a New Optimized Audio Box - DMX 6 Fire USB

A legend returns – Mac support included! The Nettetal-based audio card specialist TerraTec Electronic is set to relaunch the popular 6fire audio board, albeit in a revamped, optimized USB solution. DMX 6 Fire USB is the perfect outboard audio system for musicians, DJs, and gamers with high standards for quality. The unofficial successor to DMX 6Fire 24/96 has been overhauled completely and now delivers even more powerful performance. Rather than a PCI plug-in, it features an up-to-date USB 2.0 port, and instead of 24-bits and 96 kHz, it now offers 24 bits and 192 kHz. DMX 6Fire USB costs 199 euros.

body:
throughout the House

The popular music portal Napster will be available on all NOXON Internet radios when this year’s international IFA consumer electronics fair winds up. Users can then enjoy wireless access to the entire Napster music database. The music Web site currently offers more than six million tracks. Access to Napster will be free for buyers and owners of TerraTec NOXON products for a month. After this introductory period, they can opt to subscribe to Napster’s service for just ten euros a month. The free trial period ends automatically after 30 days. Unfortunately for users in other countries, this offering will initially be limited to Germany and the United Kingdom.

body:
Easy Connection to Video Recorder, Sat Receivers, Camcorders, and DVD Players – Even via Scart

The Nettetal-based multimedia vendor TerraTec now affords users effortless access to the world of digital video with Grabster AV 350 MX. This external video converter connects camcorders, DVD players, sat receivers, video recorders, and other sources equipped with analog video outputs to any PC or notebook – conveniently and easily via the box’s integrated Scart port. The TerraTec Edition of MAGIX Movies on CD & DVD software is also part of the package, so recording, cutting, and archiving videos using a computer couldn’t be any easier. And the same goes for burning for DVD quickly and conveniently. Priced at 99.99 euros, Grabster AV 350 MX ships in September.

body:
with DVB-T, DVB-C, Analog TV and Radio Reception and HDTV Support

Hybrid technology is all about diversity and options. And people who opt for the new Cinergy HTC USB XS HD have all the options covered when it comes to reception and media. Made by the Nettetal-based multimedia specialist TerraTec Electronic, this TV stick is able to receive DVB-T, DVB-C, and even analog signals. Equipped with the necessary codec set, it is even ready for HDTV. Analog video and audio inputs as well as onboard DVB-T, DVB C, and an FM radio neatly wrap up this media-enabling package. The USB 2.0 stick is available with a 99.99 euro price tag.

body:
with TerraTec’s Cinergy T USB XE and Cinergy Hybrid RC - Everywhere, All the Time

2008 promises to be a big year in sports, first with the European Cup in early summer, followed by the Olympic Games in August. For those who wish to see all the best games and finals in the hottest competitions, the time to gear up is now. And TerraTec Electronic offers the perfect solutions with two special sports packages that bring these events to the computer. Best of all, these solutions are priced affordably for every budget. Cinergy T USB XE, a USB stick enabling digital TV reception (DVB-T) on the go, will be ship in May, selling for 29.99 euros. The Nettetal-based multimedia vendor TerraTec will also bring to market Cinergy Hybrid RC, a hybrid USB-solution (analog TV and DVB-T) priced at 59.99 euros.

A simple yet brilliant concept has all but reinvented radio! Courtesy of direct Internet access, listeners can now enjoy any of more than 10,000 radio stations worldwide at home, as easily as dialing up a program on a conventional radio! Stations are sorted by genre or language in the customary manner, making it very easy for users to find the broadcasts that interest them most. Priced at 299 euros, NOXON iRadio for iPod will ship in May.

Simply connect the USB 2.0 tuner to the computer, and the Mac will receive all programs in digital picture quality. Selling for 129 euros , Cinergy S USB Mac will ship end of February.

body:
TerraTec Unveils the World’s First USB Stereo Interfacial Microphone – iQuader

A simple solution featuring sophisticated technology, iQuader by TerraTec Electronic is the perfect microphone for capturing high-quality recordings. It is sure to delight the target group of radio and other journalists, media specialists, and people engaged in other creative professions. Developed in cooperation with Brauner Microphones, this solution enables fast, simple recording. Renowned for their technology expertise, both companies applied their different skill sets to endow iQuader with unique audio characteristics and excellent sound quality for live recording, pod-casting, interviews, and VoIP. Priced at 249 euros, TerraTec’s iQuader will hit stores at the end of January.

body:
Mobile + Stereo - Analog + Digital! TerraTec’s new TV Stick Now Comes with an FM Tuner

Something very good - TerraTec Electronic’s tremendously popular TV solution Cinergy hybrid T USB XS FM - just got better. No larger than a Swiss Army knife, it now features a stereo FM tuner to satisfy the demands of a growing radio audience. Priced at 99.99 euros (169 CHF), Cinergy hybrid T USB XS FM receives digital as well as analog television signals in stereo quality. The ultra compact TV tuner connects easily and conveniently to notebooks and PCs via USB 2.0. That is all it takes for users to view all analog and digital TV stations available in the area. The hardware with corresponding Elgato software (EyeTV) will be available to the Apple community at the end of January for 129 euros (219 CHF).
